subject.title: Feature: configurable LLM retry with backoff on transient errors (overloaded/529)

question: What permanent public retry contract should OpenClaw expose for main LLM requests: provider-level, agent/global, both, or no new config surface?
rationale: The request adds public configuration and changes provider/fallback runtime behavior, while repository policy treats these surfaces as compatibility-sensitive and the open candidate PRs cover only partial shapes.

options.title: Settle Provider-Level Retry First
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98110 or a successor as the config direction only after maintainers approve the API and require runtime wiring before this issue can close.

options.title: Design Agent/Global Retry Policy
options.body: Specify an agents.defaults style policy with retry classes, backoff array, total cap, idempotency rules, and notification semantics before accepting provider-level fields.

options.title: Reject New Retry Config
options.body: Keep existing failover, cooldown, and cron retry paths and close the feature direction only if maintainers explicitly decide the extra config surface is not worth the complexity.

recommendation.title: Settle Provider-Level Retry First
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98110 or a successor as the config direction only after maintainers approve the API and require runtime wiring before this issue can close.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest retry/failover product-history owner among the likely owners and authored the closest maintainer-side retry design discussion.
